result-alias.reason: the result (or a stored out-pointer) aliases an argument or retained storage; v1 has no result mode meaning 'aliases parameter n' (`LIBC-MEM-RESULT-ALIAS`)

abi-restrict.reason: faithful in v1, but the prototype spells a qualifier after the `*` (`T *__restrict p`); the declared-ABI reader withdrew the declaration at every call site (`LOADER-ABI-RESTRICT-QUALIFIER`, measured by this card's trial run)

abi-sockaddr-union.reason: `__CONST_SOCKADDR_ARG` is a transparent union under `_GNU_SOURCE`; the reader withdrew the declaration at every call site

abi-enum-typedef.reason: first parameter is the enumeration typedef `__rlimit_resource_t`, which the reader does not project; withdrawn at every call site

abi-va-list.reason: takes a `va_list` (`__builtin_va_list`), for which v1 has no ABI spelling

no-return.reason: does not return; v1 has no no-return mode and a `normal` clause would add a continuation the C does not have

descriptor-or-handle-lifecycle.reason: creates or releases a descriptor, stream, directory, library or result-list handle; v1 custody is pointer-only and kind-less, so a neutral declaration would erase the obligation and an owned/released pair would conflate it with `malloc`/`free`

in-place-object-lifecycle.reason: initialises or destroys an object the caller owns in place (a destroy obligation v1 cannot state)

retains-pointer.reason: retains its pointer argument past the call without an owner v1 can name

callback.reason: invokes a caller-supplied function whose effects the declaration cannot state

pointer-to-pointer-borrow.reason: writes through `void **`; `ptr<mut, ptr<mut, u8>>` admits only `resource_out`

header-inline-body.reason: defined `static __inline` by a glibc header inside the unit: a checkable body, not an external prototype, so a name-keyed contract would replace it with an assumption
